desc: Analyze the min-cost flow on a line with supplies cnt[i] and demands final[i] (0 or f), with edges i->i+1 cost 1, and node delete/insert cost 1. Confirm simple weight-based model is correct.
Attempt to construct a counterexample where the simple "pick k smallest |cnt-f| - cnt" model overestimates the true minimum due to shift operations. None found; model is correct.
Implement the solution in the starter code: iterate k=1..min(26,n), f=1..n, compute weights, sort, sum k smallest, track global minimum.
Test on provided examples ("acab"->1, "wddw"->0, "aaabc"->2) and edge cases (n=3, single letter, all same letter, all distinct letters, maximum n).
